name: FisherRF
aliases: Active View Selection and Mapping with Radiance Fields Using Fisher Information
definition: A method for active view selection and uncertainty quantification in Radiance Fields that directly quantifies observed information on model parameters using Fisher Information, selecting candidate views by maximizing Expected Information Gain (EIG).
summary: FisherRF is a method for active view selection in Radiance Fields that uses Fisher Information to maximize expected information gain, leveraging Hessian sparsity for real-time performance.
